title: Enhanced Observability & Project Provisioning
summary: Discovery Engine gains new observability controls, allowing you to persist agent artifacts to GCS and enable user principal logging. Project provisioning also gets a new 'pre-provision' mode for more flexible setup workflows.
details: The `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1alphaObservabilityConfig` schema now includes two new optional fields: `artifactGcsBucket` (string) to specify a Cloud Storage bucket for persisting agent-generated artifacts, and `userPrincipalLoggingEnabled` (boolean) to log end-user identities in activity logs even when sensitive logging is off. These provide better debugging and auditing capabilities for agent interactions. Additionally, the `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1betaProvisionProjectRequest` now accepts an optional `preProvisionMode` (boolean). When set to `true`, this flag allows you to run only common project-level pre-provisioning steps without affecting customer, collection, or user store data, streamlining initial project setup for specific automation needs.
